summary: Ware County, GA steel tower of about 120 ft, built 1949; the county sold the structure at auction in 2006; recorded as removed, no site description.

facts.status_note: Sold at public auction in 2006; listed as 'to be removed' and then 'Removed'; no source describes the site now

events.note: lookout structure sold at public auction for $2,075.00 by the Ware County Board of Commissioners

evidence.supports: record headed with Ware County and Georgia Forestry Commission
record headed with Georgia Forestry Commission
sold by Ware County Board of Commissioners at public auction in 2006
evidence.quote: April 10, 2006: The Ware County Board of Commissioners sold the lookout structure at public auction for $2,075.00.

evidence.supports: location in Ware County, northwest of Waycross
evidence.quote: It is located northwest of Waycross

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Georgia list says 'to be removed' while the Forest Lookouts record ends with 'Removed'; the tower is treated as gone, but no source gives a removal date

notes_for_editor: Ownership conflict: the record is headed Ware County - Georgia Forestry Commission, yet the county sold the structure in 2006; brief's ownership 'state' was not changed. A GovDeals auction listing ('FIRE TOWER used by the Georgia Forestry Commission', located 1.3 miles west of the Bickley Fire Station) appeared in search, but govdeals.com returned HTTP 403 and it is not cited; it may date the sale and show the site, so worth a manual check. A 2006 Savannah Morning News fire-tower article also returned 403. No photos on Wikimedia Commons for this tower.
